descriptionChirho: To cook or boil food by heating in liquid (Piel active and Pual passive); the core culinary sense of בָּשַׁל covering all standard cooking references including roasting, which in biblical Hebrew falls under the same Piel semantic range rather than constituting a distinct lexical sense.
To ripen or reach maturity (of fruit or produce); a figurative extension from the heat-of-cooking domain to the natural ripening process (Qal and Hifil stems).
